ideas.idea: Support the 'thousands of patients' claim with verifiable evidence such as a review source
ideas.why: Accurate to index.njk, but trust-content advice that applies to almost any business site and has little technical effect.

ideas.idea: Add dentist names, roles, registrations and specialties on the team page
ideas.why: The team page is vague, and named, credentialed people make the clinic's expertise readable to users and machines.

ideas.idea: Add real price ranges, treatment details and appointment links on the services page
ideas.why: The services page only has a bare list and the line 'prices are simple and clear', so concrete details would help people and machines understand the offering.

ideas.idea: Add address and other business details to the Dentist JSON-LD on /contact
ideas.why: The JSON-LD has only name and telephone while the page text has an address, so adding it gives machines the clinic's location.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter social preview metadata in base.njk
ideas.why: The tags are indeed missing, but this is standard advice for any site and has little effect on finding or understanding it.

ideas.idea: Link each service to a dedicated treatment page
ideas.why: The services are plain list items, so dedicated linked pages would give crawlers and readers more depth and routes.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours in visible text on the contact page
ideas.why: The contact page has no hours, which matter for a dental clinic and could also be added to the structured data.
